guardrails: No candidate is an active IRFEN zone.
No threshold or hydraulic factor is proposed or transferred from another catchment.
A missing dataset is a validation gap, never evidence of low risk.
Each candidate requires a zone-specific validation contract before implementation.
next_normalization_steps: Extract individual official points and geometries instead of corridor names.
Attach exposed settlements, roads, services, agriculture and isolation constraints.
Compile event dates and recurrence without interpreting missing records as low recurrence.
Classify each mechanism before selecting a model or assigning a score.
Create a validation contract and data-readiness assessment for every shortlisted system.
purpose: Preparar una primera ola territorial equilibrada sin alterar los tres pilotos de v0.8 ni convertir evidencia preliminar en alertas.
